prompt: Creative fashion carousel cover, vertical 3:4, surreal scale illusion, ultra photoreal macro photography. Extreme close-up macro shot filling the frame: the chest of a person in old money attire - crisp white oxford shirt, navy grenadine silk tie with a vintage gold tie bar, herringbone tweed blazer lapel on the right edge - and their hand raised in front of the tie, fingers relaxed, wearing a gold signet ring on the pinky. Standing casually on top of the bent index finger: a tiny miniature version of the same person from the reference image, about as tall as two fingernails stacked, looking straight at the camera, both hands in pockets. The miniature wears a different old money outfit: camel overcoat over a cream turtleneck, brown pleated trousers, suede loafers. Both the giant chest and the tiny figure are the same person and the tiny figure's face matches the reference image exactly. Contrasty side lighting on the tiny figure's face. Sharp macro focus on the tie texture, tie bar and the tiny figure, soft falloff to a blurred cream townhouse background. Realistic contact shadow of the tiny figure on the finger skin. Natural daylight, muted editorial colors, shot on iphone macro, fashion carousel aesthetic.
